limitations: Only ordinary three-cut complexes of antipodally folded n-cubes for n>=5. No equivariant or persistence claim. Equivalent unindexed literature remains possible; no independent audit.
scientific_integrity: Proof gives full integral homology via elementary simplicial collapses, cubical projective quotient, integral UCT and Alexander duality; finite checks are corroboration. The theorem does not classify the homotopy type of the original cut complex.
title: Integral two-torsion in three-cut complexes of all folded hypercubes
